init_wandb_singleton: initialize a WandBSingletonLogger instance with config, run_id, run_name, log_dir, project, and entity
log_wandb_metrics: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton at a given step
log_wandb_table: log a wandb table with column names and row data using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton
watch_model_gradients: watch a PyTorch model parameters and gradients with wandb using WandBLogger or WandBSingletonLogger
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics to wandb on the master process using the log_stats convenience function
